g.title: Validated LoginEvent — entered via POST /api/v1/decisions or the in-process eval PipelineDriver.
FeatureService.compute() — sliding-window velocity + novelty + impossible-travel features over Redis state. app/features/.
Per-account hashes + sorted sets for sliding windows. TTL-managed.
AtoScorer.score() — XGBoost over AtoFeatureVector → ScorerOutput (risk_score, top SHAP signals, GateRoute). app/scorer/.

build_observation() — the only function crossing the domain → framework boundary. Translates (LoginEvent, AtoFeatureVector, ScorerOutput) into an Observation with ReasonerContext + GateContext + (fast_path_rationale on fast path).
Inspects observation.route. FAST_PATH_ALLOW < 0.20; FAST_PATH_BLOCK > 0.85; otherwise ROUTE_TO_GATE.

PolicyRetriever.retrieve() — pgvector HNSW (dense) + Elasticsearch BM25 (sparse) → RRF fusion → cross-encoder rerank (latency-budget bypass falls back to RRF-only). Filters: jurisdictions on both stores; risk_tier on pgvector only. app/retrieval/.

PolicyGate.evaluate() — resolves the YAML prompt template via prompt_template_id, renders with template_vars + retrieved snippets, calls the LLM with a structured-output schema, returns PolicyGateOutput (verdict + rationale + citations) or None on validation failure. app/gate/policy/.
Bypasses retrieval + LLM. fast_path_rationale records why. GateContext is still preserved on the bundle for retrospective shadow evaluation.

resolve(obs, verdict, snippets, decision_id) — pure deterministic rule application. Schema-failure / novel-entity / adversarial-flag / jurisdiction-conflict → HOLD. Severity ladder ALLOW < CHALLENGE < HOLD < BLOCK. Re-runnable byte-identically for replay. app/enforcement/.

build_bundle() composes the immutable DecisionBundle (raw_event Observation, retrieval results, gate_input/gate_output, enforcement decision, latency breakdown). BundleStore.write() persists JSONB to Postgres. app/audit/.
Dense policy embeddings (384-dim, cosine, HNSW).
Sparse policy index with jurisdiction + version filters.
OpenAI / Anthropic — structured-output policy-gate calls.
Append-only audit store: decision_bundles JSONB + replay_logs.
